pairs.registryProposal: section-plan-as-the-brief lets a short prose prompt stand when the purpose is exploring identity. This context's batch lane runs N identical briefs to measure provider variance and keep-rates per term, which is a learning lab, not a production piece. The technique should say whether a variance or vocabulary measurement lane counts as exploration, and whether such a lane may claim the technique as a tag (batch.ts:41) when it cannot express a plan.
